diagnosis: The scenario fails the Weak Arm gate because checks C1, C2, and C3 are satisfied by the model using only shared public facts (S1, S2, S3) without accessing the required private information (PF1, PF2, PF3). Specifically, in rollout 2, the model correctly assigned clinic_power_source to G-1 (satisfying C1), communications_power_source to G-2 (satisfying C2), and motor_pool_power_source to G-1 (satisfying C3) based solely on the general generator availability/load limits provided in the public context.

C1.why: The keyed connector requirement changes the clinic's power-source assignment from an open generator choice to exactly G-1.

C2.why: The conditioning-unit requirement changes the communications shelter's power-source assignment to exactly G-2.

C3.why: The compressor startup requirement changes the motor pool's source to G-1 and its operating window to exactly 1300-1500.

fix_instructions: Tighten checks C1, C2, and C3 by making the correct assignments non-obvious or contradictory to the public facts.
